title: ChatPanel
excerpt: Private AI in your browser. Anonymize what you send, take notes and meeting notes, and switch between in-browser, local, API and agent models — all on your machine.
content_html:
Browser side panel (Chrome, Edge, Brave & Arc) · private by default · any model or agent

Your AI, your data,
right beside the web.

Notes, meetings, and whatever tab you're on — in one panel that runs on your machine. Bring any model or agent and swap between them mid-conversation, while sensitive details are anonymized before they leave your browser and restored in the reply you read. No ChatPanel server in the middle.

Chat the moment you install — a private AI model runs right in your browser, no API key, no account, nothing to set up.
Works in Chrome, Edge, Brave & Arc. Move to a local model, a cloud API, or your own agent anytime.

A side panel isn't the point — every browser ships one now. The point is that this one is yours: your model or agent, your notes and meetings as context, your sensitive data anonymized before it ever leaves the browser.

What actually makes it different

Six things a built-in browser assistant won't do for you.

Privacy first

Nothing leaves without your say

No ChatPanel server sits in the path. Emails, phones, cards and keys — and with on-device AI, names, orgs and locations — are anonymized on your machine before a request goes out, then de-anonymized in the reply. The same protection can wrap the agents you already use.

Note taking

A notebook your AI writes with you

Linked, wiki-style notes your AI can research, co-write and restructure alongside you — capture from any page, then turn a selection into a plan without leaving the panel.

Meetings

A meeting assistant for every major platform

Zoom, Meet, Teams and Webex — running notes, decisions and action items straight from the live captions. It all happens in your browser: no bot joins your call, nothing is uploaded.

Independence

Never locked to one model

The in-browser model, Ollama or LM Studio on your laptop, 20+ cloud APIs, or agents like Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity under your own logins — switch between them mid-conversation.

Shared context

One memory across everything

Notes, meetings and past chats live in a single searchable store, so an answer can draw on last week's call, a note from March, and the page in front of you at once.

Real tools

Actions, not just answers

MCP servers and browser actions give your AI real reach — and when you point it at a coding agent, its own tools come with it, so you get the full power of what you already pay for.

Privacy that travels with you

Anonymize sensitive data before it reaches any model

ChatPanel strips PII out of everything you send — emails, phones, cards and keys, plus (with on-device AI) names, organizations and locations — and puts it back in the reply you read. The model only ever sees opaque placeholders; your real values are restored for you.

Reversible anonymization swaps a value for a placeholder the model can still reason about, then restores it for you. Pseudonymize permanently swaps a name for an alias. Detection runs locally, you choose which categories to protect — and the same protection extends to the agents you already use, so Claude Code, Codex or any OpenAI-compatible client can sit behind it too.

Free: secrets Pro: AI auto-detect

Model & agent independence

Never locked to one model

Start on the in-browser model, move to Ollama on your laptop, jump to a cloud API, then hand the same conversation to Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity running under your own logins. Switch mid-conversation — your panel, history and tools don't change.

A one-time helper app connects the local agents. Prefer a cloud or local model instead? Skip the helper and point ChatPanel straight at it.

Free Quick setup

Real abilities

Give your AI hands — and borrow your agent's

On its own, a chat model can only talk. Add MCP tools from a built-in directory and it can search, pull in live data, and work with your other apps on your behalf. Point the panel at a coding agent and its own tools come along too, so you get the full power of the agent you already pay for — right inside the chat.

Start with one tool for free; add as many as you like with Pro. Advanced users can even share their own browser back to other agents.

Free More with Pro Quick setup

Shared context

Your notes, meetings and chats — one memory

Everything you capture lands in a single searchable store on your computer: past conversations, linked notes, and meeting transcripts. Ask a question and the answer can draw on last week's call and the page you're on. Open a visual map of it all, grouped by topic, and jump straight back in.

Free

Meetings

A meeting assistant for every major platform

On Zoom, Meet, Teams, and Webex, ChatPanel turns the live captions into running notes, decisions, and action items — plus a transcript you can search or ask about afterward. It runs entirely in your browser: no bot joins the call, and nothing is uploaded.

Reads the meeting's captions only — never your audio or video. Free covers your first 10 meetings; Pro is unlimited.

Free: first 10 Pro: unlimited Quick setup

Skills

Your go-to prompts, one tap away

Save the things you ask for again and again — summarize, explain, review — as one-tap shortcuts. Use the built-ins, or write your own and drop them into any chat.

Free Custom with Pro

And a few more things

Smaller touches that add up. Most take a quick one-time setup.

On-screen context

Ask about what you're looking at Free

Pull in the current tab, other tabs you pick, highlighted text, or a link you paste — and only when you ask for it.

Browser actions

Let it fill forms & click Free

Turn on Act on Page and ask in plain words. ChatPanel fills in fields, picks options, and clicks for you — only when you switch it on, and it checks with you before sensitive steps.

Diagrams & whiteboards

Draw on canvas apps, cleanly Pro

On Excalidraw, draw.io, and tldraw, your agent builds shapes as structured data — exact positions, in one pass — instead of nudging the mouse around. Flowcharts, diagrams, and wireframes come out crisp. On Free it falls back to slow pixel-drawing.

In-browser AI

Chat instantly, no setup Free

The moment you install, a small private model runs right in your browser on WebGPU — no API key, no account, nothing to run. Your first message downloads it once (~700 MB), then it works offline. Want more power? Connect Ollama or LM Studio, or bring your own API key. Nothing you type ever leaves your machine.

Your own agent

Plug in any command-line tool Pro

Already use OpenCode, Pi, or a script of your own? Point ChatPanel at it and it works like any built-in agent.

Export & backup

Take your data anywhere Pro

Back up your settings and conversations to a single file, then restore them on another machine.

Switch freely

Many agents, one panel Free

Set up several agents and models, then switch between them in the middle of a conversation.

Notes

Capture anything, link everything Free

Capture anything into linked notes with [[wiki-links]], then let your AI co-write, research across your workspace and the web, and turn a selection into a plan — right in the note. Free keeps your first 10 notes; Pro is unlimited.

Voice

Talk instead of type Free

With the Gateway installed, speech-to-text runs on your own machine — dictate chats, notes, and questions, transcribed locally by an on-device model. Your audio never leaves your computer, and no cloud key is needed.

Bring almost any AI provider

Choose from 20+ ready-made presets or add your own. Many providers have free tiers. Sign in or paste a key — whichever yours uses — and your credentials stay in your browser.

Sign in

No keys to copy

For providers that support it, just sign in from the panel. No tokens to paste or manage.

OpenRouter Hugging Face Gemini

Your own server

Private & local endpoints

Point ChatPanel at a private gateway or a model running on your own machine. Full control over the connection.

Ollama LMLM Studio LCllama.cpp VLvLLM +Custom

Setting one up takes about a minute: pick a provider, add your sign-in or key, load the model list, and run a quick Test to confirm it works.

Private by design

ChatPanel has no cloud in the middle. Your prompts, keys, notes, meetings and history stay on your machine; what you send goes straight to the AI you picked — anonymized first, if you want it — and nowhere else.

On your machine

Local-first

Conversations, notes, meeting transcripts, keys and settings live on your computer. Content only ever goes to the model or agent you chose.

Anonymized on the way out

The model sees placeholders

Names, emails, phones, cards and keys are swapped for tokens before a request leaves your browser, then restored in the reply — and the same shield can front your existing agents.

No middleman

We never see your chats

There's no ChatPanel server in the path. We don't store, route, or read your conversations — ever.

Install in two minutes

No developer tools needed. Install from the Chrome Web Store or Microsoft Edge Add-ons, then connect a model — a provider with a free tier, your own key, or a free local app like Ollama. The last step (the helper app) is optional and only needed for local Claude Code, Codex & Antigravity.

How to load the .zip (manual install, ~1 min)
  1. Download chatpanel-extension.zip and unzip it to a folder you’ll keep.
  2. Load it. Open chrome://extensions (Edge: edge://extensions), turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked, and pick the unzipped folder (the one with manifest.json).
  1. Connect a model. Open Settings → API, choose a provider, add your sign-in or key, load the model list, pick one, and click Test.
  2. (Optional) Install the Bridge helper app — it lets the browser extension drive your local Claude Code, Codex & Antigravity. Runs quietly in the background; ChatPanel finds it automatically. 
    # macOS / Linux — one line, no extra tools needed
curl -fsSL https://dl.chatpanel.net/bridge/install.sh | bash

# Windows (PowerShell) — no Node needed
irm https://dl.chatpanel.net/bridge/install.ps1 | iex
    Just want to try it once? npx @chatpanel/bridge runs it in the foreground. The --install step keeps it running at login.
  3. (Optional, advanced) Install the Privacy Gateway — a local, privacy-focused model router. It redacts every request with a bundled NER (names, orgs, locations) and routes the cleaned request to either a model API (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible) or your local CLI agents via the Bridge. Any OpenAI-compatible client — a terminal agent (OpenCode, Pi, aider) or the ChatPanel extension itself — can point at it. 
    # macOS / Linux
curl -fsSL https://dl.chatpanel.net/gateway/install.sh | bash

# Windows (PowerShell)
irm https://dl.chatpanel.net/gateway/install.ps1 | iex

# or via npm (any OS, needs Node)
npm i -g @chatpanel/gateway && chatpanel-gateway --install   # redaction proxy on http://127.0.0.1:4320
    Point any OpenAI-compatible client at http://127.0.0.1:4320/v1; the gateway redacts on the way out and restores on the way back, then forwards to a model API (your key) or your subscription agents via the Bridge. More in the FAQ.

Bridge vs Gateway? The Bridge is lightweight — its one job is connecting the browser extension to your local CLI agents; most people only need this. The Privacy Gateway is a separate, privacy-focused model router: it redacts with a bundled NER and routes the cleaned request to a model API or your CLI agents — and any OpenAI-compatible client, including the extension, can point at it. Three independently-versioned pieces (extension, bridge, gateway); install only what you use.

• (Optional, advanced) Install the Privacy Gateway — a local, privacy-focused model router. Browser side panel (Chrome, Edge, Brave & Arc) · private by default · any model or agent

您的人工智能、您的数据就在网络旁边。

笔记、会议以及您所在的任何选项卡 — 在您计算机上运行的一个面板中。 带上任何模特或经纪人，并在对话中进行交换，而敏感详细信息在离开您的浏览器之前会被匿名，并在您阅读的回复中恢复。 中间没有 ChatPanel 服务器。

安装后立即聊天 - 私人 AI 模型直接在您的浏览器中运行，无需 API 密钥，无需帐户，无需设置任何内容。 适用于 Chrome、Edge、Brave 和 Arc。 随时迁移到本地模型、云 API 或您自己的代理。

侧面板不是重点——现在每个浏览器都附带一个侧面板。 关键是，这是您的：您的模型或代理，您的笔记和会议作为上下文，您的敏感数据在离开浏览器之前已匿名。

How to load the .zip (manual install, ~1 min)
  1. 下载 chatpanel-extension.zip 并将其解压缩到您要保留的文件夹中。
  2. 加载它。 打开 chrome://extensions（Edge：edge://extensions），打开开发者模式，单击加载解压后的文件夹，然后选择解压后的文件夹（带有 manifest.json 的文件夹）。
  1. 连接模型。 打开“设置”→“API”，选择一个提供商，添加您的登录名或密钥，加载模型列表，选择一个，然后单击“测试”。
  2. （可选）安装 Bridge 助手应用程序 — 它可以让浏览器扩展驱动您本地的 Claude Code、Codex 和 Antigravity。 在后台安静运行； ChatPanel 会自动找到它。 # macOS / Linux — 一行，无需额外工具curl -fsSL https://dl.chatpanel.net/bridge/install.sh | bash # Windows (PowerShell) — 不需要节点 irm https://dl.chatpanel.net/bridge/install.ps1 | iex 只是想尝试一次吗？ npx @chatpanel/bridge 在前台运行它。 --install 步骤使其在登录时保持运行。
  3. （可选，高级）安装隐私网关 - 本地、注重隐私的模型路由器。 它使用捆绑的 NER（名称、组织、位置）编辑每个请求，并通过 Bridge 将清理后的请求路由到模型 API（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容）或本地 CLI 代理。 任何与 OpenAI 兼容的客户端——终端代理（OpenCode、Pi、aider）或 ChatPanel 扩展本身——都可以指向它。 # macOS / Linux curl -fsSL https://dl.chatpanel.net/gateway/install.sh | bash # Windows (PowerShell) irm https://dl.chatpanel.net/gateway/install.ps1 | iex # 或通过 npm (任何操作系统，需要 Node) npm i -g @chatpanel/gateway && chatpanel-gateway --install # redaction proxy on http://127.0.0.1:4320 将任何 OpenAI 兼容客户端指向 http://127.0.0.1:4320/v1;网关在出去时进行编辑并在返回时进行恢复，然后通过 Bridge 转发到模型 API（您的密钥）或您的订阅代理。 更多信息请参见常见问题解答。
